title: Adding a product scene: cochange checklist
answers: What do I edit to add a new product scene?
Do I edit products.tsx by hand?
body:
Add a product scene:
1. Edit `products/<name>/manifest.tsx` `scenes`, `routes`, `urls`.
2. Add value to `Scene` enum in `frontend/src/scenes/sceneTypes.ts` (unverified whether generation makes this unnecessary).
3. Run `pnpm build:products` to regenerate `frontend/src/products.tsx`/`productScenes.tsx` (never hand-edit).
4. Page module must export `scene: SceneExport`, named to match the Scene enum.
See `frontend/src/AGENTS.md` Rule 2 for product vs scenes/ placement.
applies: Product-based scenes; core scenes are still edited by hand in scenes.ts/appScenes.ts.
